nav.groupCurrent: This group holds the screen you are on, so it stays open.

login.title: Log In
login.serverError: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
login.registered: Account created. You can log in now.
login.registeredVerify: Account created. We sent you an email to verify your address — please verify it within 30 days.
login.accountDeactivated: This account is deactivated: the administrator closed it, or its email was not verified within 30 days. Contact the administrator.
login.captchaFailed: The CAPTCHA check failed. Please try again.
login.captchaUnavailable: The CAPTCHA could not be loaded. Check your connection or disable blockers for this site.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
login.accountLocked: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. Use the link we emailed you, reset your password, or ask the administrator.

signup.title: Create Account
signup.successMessage: Account created successfully. Please log in.
signup.errorInvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
signup.errorDisposableEmail: Disposable email addresses are not allowed.

credentials.searchPlaceholder: Search by website or email / username…
credentials.noResults: No credentials match the search or filters.
credentials.noData: You have not saved any credentials yet.

saveCredential.usernameLoginCheckbox: This site uses a username instead of an email
saveCredential.errorSaveFailed: Failed to save credential. Please try again.

editCredential.usernameLoginCheckbox: This site uses a username instead of an email
editCredential.passwordPlaceholder: Leave unchanged or enter a new password
editCredential.errorUpdateFailed: Failed to update credential. Please try again.

passwordConfirmModal.title: Confirm Your Account Password
passwordConfirmModal.description: Enter your account password to continue.
passwordConfirmModal.errorGeneric: An error occurred. Please try again.

confirmDeleteModal.title: Delete Credential
confirmDeleteModal.body: Are you sure you want to permanently delete the credential for {{website}}? This action cannot be undone.

alreadyVisibleModal.title: Password Already Visible
alreadyVisibleModal.body: Another password is currently visible. Do you want to hide it and reveal this one?

admin.changeRoleError: Could not change the role. Please try again.
admin.ownRoleLocked: You cannot change your own role.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or user ID
admin.noResults: No users match the search or filters.
admin.deactivatedDeadline: Did not verify the email in time.

deactivate.label: Deactivate {{username}}
deactivate.title: Deactivate {{username}}?
deactivate.message: They will not be able to sign in and every open session ends now. Their saved passwords are kept. They get an email with the reason.
deactivate.reasonRequired: Write a reason of at least 3 characters.
deactivate.conflict: That account was already deactivated. Reload the page.

reactivate.label: Reactivate {{username}}
reactivate.title: Reactivate {{username}}?
reactivate.message: They will be able to sign in again and will get an email. An account closed for not verifying its email gets a new deadline.
reactivate.conflict: That account is not deactivated. Reload the page.

unlock.label: Unlock {{username}}
unlock.title: Unlock {{username}}?
unlock.message: The account was locked after too many wrong passwords or codes. Unlock it only if you know the person is trying to sign in.
unlock.conflict: That account is not locked. Reload the page.

reset-2fa.label: Reset two-step verification of {{username}}
reset-2fa.title: Reset two-step verification of {{username}}?
reset-2fa.message: For someone who lost their phone and recovery codes. Their sessions end and they set it up again at the next sign-in. They get an email.
reset-2fa.conflict: That account has no two-step verification. Reload the page.

forbidden.title: 403 — Access Forbidden
forbidden.message: You do not have permission to view this page.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: You are not authorized to perform this action.
errors.notFound: The requested resource was not found.
errors.networkError: Network error. Please check your connection.
errors.validationError: Please correct the errors in the form.
errors.serverError: A server error occurred. Please try again later.

verifyEmail.modalBody: Your email address is not verified yet. Open the link we sent you to verify it.
verifyEmail.modalBodyDeadline: Your email address is not verified yet. Open the link we sent you before {{date}}; after that date the account will be deactivated.
verifyEmail.resendSent: We sent you a new verification email.
verifyEmail.resendTooMany: You have requested several emails already. Please try again later.
verifyEmail.resendError: The email could not be sent. Please try again.
verifyEmail.verified: Your email has been verified. Thank you!
verifyEmail.invalidLink: This verification link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Log in to request a new one.
verifyEmail.deactivated: This account is deactivated. Contact the administrator.
verifyEmail.serverError: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

home.title: Hello, {{username}}
home.empty: Your vault is empty. Save your first credential to see it here.

form.websiteFormat: Start with a letter or a number.

help.website: The name you know the site by, for example github.com. It must start with a letter or a number.
help.email: The email you sign in with on that site. Tick the box above if the site uses a username instead.
help.username: The username you sign in with on that site.
help.credentialPassword: The password of that site. It is stored encrypted; showing it later asks for your account password.
help.credentialPasswordEdit: Type a new password to replace it, or leave the current one. It is stored encrypted.
help.signupUsername: Your name in Save-Pass. You sign in with it.
help.signupEmail: Used to verify your account and to send you security notices.
help.userCode: Your unique ID. It never changes; give it to the administrator so they find you even if someone has the same name.
help.displayName: How the app greets you and shows you in menus. Leave it empty to use your username.
help.startPage: The screen that opens after you log in.
help.privateMode: Useful in front of other people. The eye in the top bar does the same.
help.newPassword: Changing it closes your sessions on other devices.

settings.title: Settings
settings.displayNameInvalid: Use 2 to 60 letters, numbers, spaces or . , ' - _
settings.pictureRules: PNG, JPEG or WebP. It is cropped to a square and reduced before it is sent.
settings.pictureFailed: The picture could not be saved. Try another one.
settings.privateMode: Private mode: hide usernames and emails in lists
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were closed and you will get an email about it.
settings.passwordSame: The new password must be different from the current one.
settings.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
settings.endWithLogout: Use Log out to end it
settings.endSessionMessage: That device is signed out at once and has to log in again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Who did what and when, newest first. Credentials appear by number only; their contents are never shown.
audit.searchPlaceholder: Person: name, email or user ID
audit.utcNote: The date filters use UTC days; times are shown in your time zone.
audit.truncated: Showing the latest {{count}} entries. Narrow the filters to see older ones.

unlock.title: Unlock your account
unlock.ready: Press the button to unlock your account. The link works once.
unlock.done: Your account is unlocked. You can sign in again.
unlock.invalid: This link is not valid: it was already used, it expired or a newer one was sent.

system.title: System parameters
system.intro: Security values for every account. Changes apply from the next sign-in or request.
system.range: Use a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
system.nothingChanged: Nothing to save: no value changed.
system.invalid: A value is out of range. Nothing was saved.

lockout_attempts.label: Failed attempts before locking
lockout_attempts.help: Wrong passwords or codes in a row that lock an account. The owner gets an email with an unlock link.

admin_reauth_minutes.label: Minutes before administration asks for the password again
admin_reauth_minutes.help: Administration actions ask for your account password at most once in this time. 0 asks every time. Credentials always ask.

session_idle_minutes.label: Minutes of inactivity before signing out
session_idle_minutes.help: Without activity in any tab for this long, the session ends. A warning appears one minute before.

session_max_minutes.label: Maximum session length (minutes)
session_max_minutes.help: A session ends after this long even with activity. A warning one minute before lets you extend it.

session_extend_minutes.label: Minutes added by “Extend”
session_extend_minutes.help: How much longer a session lasts when someone presses Extend near the maximum.

email.title: Email
email.verification: Ask new accounts to verify their email
email.verificationHelp: New accounts get a link and 30 days to open it; unverified accounts are then deactivated.
email.noBaseUrl: Needs the server's public address (APP_BASE_URL in the installation settings) for the links.
email.smtpHelp: Leave the server empty to use the installation's setting (now: {{backend}}).
email.passwordSaved: Saved — leave empty to keep it
email.incomplete: With a server, the sender address and a port from 1 to 65535 are required.
email.invalid: Some value is not valid. Nothing was saved.

testSent.console: Written to the server's console: no SMTP is configured.
testSent.file: Written to the server's outbox folder: no SMTP is configured.

twoFactor.setupRequired: Every Save-Pass account uses a second step: a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone. Set it up now; it takes a minute.
twoFactor.step1: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS…).
twoFactor.step2: Scan the code with the app, or type the key below.
twoFactor.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code to add Save-Pass to your authenticator app
twoFactor.openInApp: Open in the authenticator app on this device
twoFactor.manual: Can't scan? Type this key in the app:
twoFactor.codeFormat: Type the 6 digits the app shows.
twoFactor.wrongCode: That code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and use the newest code.
twoFactor.expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
twoFactor.codeIntro: Open your authenticator app and type the code for Save-Pass.
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: Type one of your recovery codes. Each one works once.
twoFactor.recoveryFormat: A recovery code has 10 letters and digits, like ABCDE-23456.
twoFactor.codesIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe, away from this device. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.newDeviceIntro: Confirm your password. Your current phone keeps working until the new one is confirmed with a code.
twoFactor.newCodesIntro: Confirm your password and a code from the app. The old recovery codes stop working.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Type your username or email. If the account exists, we email a link to choose a new password (valid for 1 hour).
forgot.sent: If that account exists, we sent a link to its email. Check your inbox (and spam). The link works once, for 1 hour.
forgot.tooMany: Too many requests. Wait a while and try again.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.note: Your saved passwords are kept. Every session is closed, and signing in still asks for your two-step code.
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with it (and your two-step code).
reset.invalid: This link is not valid: it was already used, it expired or a newer one was sent.

session.warningTitle: Your session is about to end
session.idleWarning: No activity for a while: you will be signed out in {{seconds}} s.
session.maxWarning: This session reaches its maximum length in {{seconds}} s.
session.endedIdle: You were signed out after a while without activity. Sign in again.
session.endedMax: Your session reached its maximum length. Sign in again.

helpPage.userIntro: How to use Save-Pass. Search ignores capitals and accents.
helpPage.technicalIntro: Administration, installation and maintenance. Only the Admin sees this guide.

generator.title: Password generator
generator.chooseOne: Choose at least one kind of character.

strength.weak: Weak · about {{bits}} bits. Make it longer or add kinds of characters.

accountData.title: Your data
accountData.exportIntro: Download every saved password to keep a copy or move to another password manager. The file is not encrypted: keep it safe and delete it when done.
accountData.downloaded: Downloaded. We sent you an email about it.
accountData.deleteIntro: Erases every saved password, your settings, picture, sessions and two-step data. It cannot be undone. Export first if you want a copy.
accountData.typeUsername: Type your username exactly to confirm.
accountData.deleted: Your account and its passwords were deleted.
accountData.wrongCodeOrName: The code or the username is not right.
accountData.lastAdmin: You are the only administrator: make someone else Admin first.
